parameters.query:
SELECT 1 AS ok,
       m.tipo,
       m.fecha,
       m.datos
FROM (SELECT 1) AS ping
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT tipo, fecha, datos
  FROM eventos
  WHERE tipo IN ('modelo.monitoreado', 'modelo.deriva_detectada')
  ORDER BY fecha DESC
  LIMIT 1
) AS m ON true;
